findings.what: emit_notice passes message and code in the wrong order to safe_parts(fmt, code, message), so every notice prints its message in the `code` slot and its code in the `message` slot, in both JSON (`notice.code`/`notice.message`) and table (`notice[{code}]: {message}`) output; the code also gets the format-aware message cleaning and the message gets only the plain code cleaning.
